# filesystem-mcp

FastMCP 3.4+ server for file system operations, directory management, content
search, and code intelligence (todos, symbols, project analysis, ruff lint,
config validation) — with per-path concurrency-safe atomic writes.
System monitoring and host context included. Docker tools are present but
deprecated (docker-mcp owns that surface); git lives in git-github-mcp.

> **Full documentation**: [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt) — complete tool catalog,
> response contracts, configuration, architecture, and troubleshooting.

## Key Facts

- 24 MCP tools, portmanteau grouped (file_ops, dir_ops, search_ops, container_ops,
  infra_ops, host_ops + compose, monitoring, agentic workflow, shutdown)
- file_ops: + get_file_hash, append_file, touch_file, compress, decompress
- dir_ops: + copy_tree (shutil default, robocopy opt-in on Windows), move_directory
- search_ops: + find_todos, find_symbols, validate_json, analyze_project,
  run_linter (ruff-only), validate_config
- Dual transport: stdio (IDE clients) + HTTP streamable (webapp, LAN, Tailscale)
- Atomic writes with per-path asyncio locks and automatic `.backup` files
- Ports: backend 10742, webapp frontend 10743 (dev)
- REST: /api/health, /api/status, /api/capabilities, /api/skills,
  /api/llm/discover, /api/llm/chat, /api/v1/diagnostics
